title: Spyglass: Now Generally Available
summary: We're thrilled to announce the official launch of Spyglass, bringing its powerful capabilities to all users for an elevated experience.

title: Ultimate File Control in the Editor
summary: Gain ultimate command over your content with powerful new tools to effortlessly manage, upload, and customize how all your embedded files are displayed directly within the editor.

title: Introducing Our New Public Roadmap
summary: We are excited to introduce our new public roadmap, providing a transparent and engaging look at our product's evolution, from recent achievements to future plans.

title: Enhanced Checkboxes
summary: Enjoy a smoother workflow with our newly designed checkboxes, now bigger, easier to drag, and perfectly aligned with our sleek, modern interface.

title: Enhanced Real-time Collaboration
summary: Experience seamless teamwork with our enhanced real-time collaboration features, making it incredibly intuitive and efficient to work together.

title: Enhanced Collaboration and Shared Content
summary: Seamlessly discover and collaborate on shared content with enhanced visibility, ensuring you always find and engage with relevant ideas and quests.

title: Noeko is Now Open Source!
summary: We're thrilled to open-source Noeko's codebase, empowering our community with maximum control and direct involvement in shaping its exciting future.

title: Unlock Global Languages
summary: We're thrilled to bring Noeko to users worldwide by introducing extensive support for multiple international languages.

title: Revitalized Themes and Expanded Style Choices
summary: Elevate your visual experience with beautifully polished existing themes and a fantastic array of brand new styles designed to bring fresh appeal to your interface.

title: Intelligent Constellation View
summary: Explore your knowledge base with unprecedented clarity and effortlessly discover connections using powerful new filtering and sharing capabilities.

title: Refined Search & Curated Collections
summary: Experience a more powerful search that lets you filter your knowledge by tags and time, and save these refined views as custom collections for instant access.

title: Smart Content Previews
summary: We're empowering you to arrange your notes more effectively with new, dynamic display options that make linked content instantly accessible and interactive.

title: Noeko: Unleash Your Potential with Flexible Hosting and Enhanced Plans
summary: Get ready to deploy Noeko your way with new self-hosting capabilities and powerful paid plans designed to scale with your needs.

title: Enhanced Time-Aware Greetings
summary: We're rolling out an update to ensure your homepage greetings perfectly reflect the time of day, offering a more precise and welcoming experience.

title: Streamlined Tag Curation
summary: Gain powerful control over your tagged items with new bulk actions, allowing you to quickly unapply tags or delete items directly from list views.

title: Unlock a World of Information
summary: Seamlessly integrate and interact with a wider variety of content formats, including videos, web pages, and plain text, to enrich your insights and streamline your research workflow.
